live_hypotheses.label: EQ_EXTENSION_LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: In the S&P MidCap 400 + SmallCap 600 PIT universe, a long-short book that buys the least liquid quintile and sells the most liquid quintile - liquidity measured as a turnover-scaled Amihud-style illiquidity rank, sector-neutralised - earns a positive net return over 21 sessions after realistic small-cap costs.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Compensation for the expected cost of trading. An investor who must be able to exit quickly pays a premium for liquid names; the marginal holder of an illiquid name must be paid to bear exit risk. The premium is a price of a real service, not a forecast.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: Not new information - a new POPULATION. The premium is measured where limits to arbitrage bind, instead of among the 500 most-arbitraged securities on earth.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Because harvesting it requires accepting the very illiquidity being paid for. Large institutions cannot size into it, so the premium is not competed away; it is structurally unattractive rather than unknown.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: The estate's LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM near-miss (lockbox t 2.89, killed by burden correction) was measured on the S&P 500. LIQUIDITY is not in the closed_mechanism_ledger for US_EQUITY at all. The population is the hypothesis.

live_hypotheses.label: EQ_EXTENSION_RESIDUAL_MOMENTUM
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: In the extension universe, ranking on 12-month-minus-1-month momentum measured in RESIDUAL space - after removing market and sector return - produces a positive net long-short return over 21 sessions.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Slow diffusion of firm-specific news. Residualising strips the market and sector components, so what remains is idiosyncratic underreaction rather than a disguised beta or sector bet.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: Coverage: mid and small caps are followed by fewer analysts, so firm-specific information diffuses more slowly than in the large-cap names the estate has already mined 1,858 times.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Attention is scarce and is allocated to large caps. Nobody is paid to be the marginal informed holder of a $900m company.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: PRICE_STATE_EQUITY_FACTORS is closed on the S&P 500 panel. This is a different population and an explicitly residualised construct. It is nonetheless the WEAKEST novelty claim in the pool - it is still a price formula, only on a new panel - and should be dropped first if budget is tight.

live_hypotheses.label: EQ_EXTENSION_GROSS_PROFITABILITY
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: In the extension universe, a long-short book ranked on gross profits scaled by total assets - built only from SEC facts whose filed date precedes the decision date - earns a positive net return over 21 sessions.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Gross profitability is the cleanest available measure of productive efficiency, sitting above the accounting lines most exposed to managerial discretion. Profitable firms out-earn unprofitable ones and the market underweights the persistence.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: PIT fundamentals for a population where accounting quality is more dispersed and analyst coverage thinner, from companyfacts rather than the 885-name S&P 500 fundamental panel.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Small-cap fundamentals are expensive to process relative to the position size they can support.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: PIT_FUNDAMENTALS_AND_VALUATION is closed with the explicit scope qualifier '(S&P 500)'. This is the extension universe and a profitability rather than valuation construct.

live_hypotheses.label: EQ_EXTENSION_NET_SHARE_ISSUANCE
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: In the extension universe, firms that INCREASED shares outstanding over the prior year underperform firms that reduced them, over 63 sessions, with the share count taken from the latest SEC filing whose filed date precedes the decision date.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Managers issue equity when they believe it is expensive and repurchase when they believe it is cheap. The share count is a revealed managerial valuation opinion, backed by the firm's own money - not a forecast, an action.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: The issuance decision is disclosed on the cover page of every filing but is not a headline number; it is buried where nobody in this estate has ever looked. Small caps issue and dilute far more aggressively than large caps, so the signal has more variance to work with.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The dilution is gradual and the disclosure is unglamorous; there is no announcement moment to react to.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: No issuance or corporate-financing family appears anywhere in the closed_mechanism_ledger. Explicitly NOT built from nd.sharesoutstanding, which the probe proved is a current scalar (263909000.0, '2026-07-31') and would be look-ahead contaminated.

live_hypotheses.label: FUT_OPEN_INTEREST_GROWTH_CROSS_SECTION
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: Ranking futures markets by the trailing growth in EXCHANGE open interest on the held contract - observed with the mandated one-session delay - and going short the markets with the fastest open-interest expansion against long the markets with contracting open interest earns a positive net return over 21 sessions.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Rapid open-interest growth means new capital is crowding into a position. Crowded positions are fragile: they need continued inflow to sustain the price, and they unwind violently. Open interest measures how much capital must eventually exit.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: Real exchange open interest per dated contract, present in the R38 native layer (CL.csv carries an open_interest column across 10,897 sessions and 521 contracts) and in all 27,451 dated Norgate symbols. Twelve hypotheses have ever touched this layer, against 5,846 on the back-adjusted panel.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Open interest is published with a one-session provisional lag and is revised, so it is awkward to use and most systematic participants ignore it in favour of price.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: COT_HEDGING_PRESSURE is closed, and this must not use CFTC trader categories at all - it is total exchange open interest, a different quantity from a different publisher on a daily rather than weekly clock.

live_hypotheses.label: FUT_BASIS_MOMENTUM_COMMODITY
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: The difference between the cumulative return of the front contract and that of the first-deferred contract over the trailing quarter - basis momentum - predicts the next 21 sessions of front-contract return cross-sectionally across commodity markets.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Basis momentum captures the CHANGE in the shape of the curve, which reflects the evolving imbalance between hedging demand at different maturities, rather than the static level of the carry.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: It is only computable with a genuine deferred leg. The census records that futures_panel_v1 cannot supply one; the 27,451 dated Norgate contracts can.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: It requires simultaneously maintaining two contract series per market with correct roll handling, which is an infrastructure cost most participants avoid.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS is closed on the slope LEVEL; this is the second difference - the change in the front-deferred relation - and CALENDAR_TERM_STRUCTURE_ROLL_STATE_R59 was withdrawn on ~14 effective observations, not settled on economics. The distinction must be stated in the pre-registered text and the effective-observation count must be reported up front, or the skeptic will kill it for the same reason.

live_hypotheses.label: EQ_DIVIDEND_CHANGE_ANNOUNCEMENT_DRIFT
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: Firms that ANNOUNCE a dividend increase or initiation - dated by declaration date, not ex-date - outperform firms announcing a cut or omission over the following 63 sessions, with entry at the next open after the declaration.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Dividend policy is sticky and management is reluctant to cut. Raising the dividend is therefore a costly, credible commitment about expected future cash flow; cutting it is a confession. The action is expensive to fake.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: The declaration date. Verified on disk to exist in the EODHD /div payload and to be carried into the record's availability stamp (JPM: ex-date 2026-07-06, declarationDate 2026-05-18 -> available_at 2026-05-18) - a seven-week gap that any ex-date-based study would have got backwards.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Dividend announcements are unscheduled, unglamorous, and scattered across the calendar; they attract none of the attention an earnings date does.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: DIVIDEND_MONTH_DEMAND_PREMIUM is closed - that is seasonal demand for yield around the ex-date, a flow story with no announcement in it. This is an information event dated by the announcement.

live_hypotheses.label: EQ_EXTENSION_H5_LIQUIDITY_PROVISION_REVERSAL
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: In the extension universe, stocks with the largest 5-session decline on elevated own-name turnover reverse over the following 5 sessions, entered at the next open, and the reversal survives a doubled small-cap cost assumption.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Payment for immediacy. A seller who must exit now moves the price against themselves; whoever absorbs the inventory is compensated when the price recovers. The compensation is larger where market-making capital is scarcer.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: H1-H5 is 0.45% of the entire estate (38 tests) and equity short-horizon reversal is closed only on the S&P 500. Turnover, not signal, is the binding constraint, so the cost model is the experiment.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Providing immediacy in small caps requires balance sheet and risk tolerance that is genuinely scarce; the compensation is a real fee for a real service, not a mispricing.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: SHORT_HORIZON_REVERSAL_GAP_FADE is closed with the explicit scope qualifier '(S&P 500)'. Must be pre-registered with the doubled-cost adversarial result reported as a primary, not a footnote - a 5-session small-cap book is exactly where a cost assumption manufactures alpha.

live_hypotheses.label: EQ_EXTENSION_IDIOSYNCRATIC_VOLATILITY
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: In the extension universe, stocks in the highest quintile of residual (idiosyncratic) volatility underperform the lowest quintile over 21 sessions, sector-neutral.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Lottery preference plus short-sale constraints. Investors overpay for the small chance of a large payoff, and the overpricing cannot be arbitraged away because the expensive names are the hardest to borrow. Both forces are strongest in small caps.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: Population, again, plus the fact that VOLATILITY carries a search burden of 13 across the whole estate - it is the least-mined asset class we own.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The correction requires shorting small, volatile, hard-to-borrow stocks - precisely the trade that is most expensive and most career-hazardous to hold.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: No idiosyncratic-volatility family appears in the closed_mechanism_ledger for US_EQUITY; PRICE_STATE_EQUITY_FACTORS is closed on the S&P 500 panel. This is nonetheless a price-derived construct and should be treated as a lower-novelty entry, behind PH01 and PH03.

live_hypotheses.label: FUT_INTL_INDEX_OPEN_INTEREST_CONCENTRATION
live_hypotheses.hypothesis: Across international equity index futures (FDAX, FESX, FCE, FSMI, HSI, KOS, SNK, SCN, SXF, AWM, GWM), the trailing growth in exchange open interest on the held contract predicts lower subsequent 21-session returns cross-sectionally.
live_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Same crowding mechanism as PH07, applied where capital flows are lumpier: international index futures are the vehicle for cross-border allocation, so open-interest expansion is a direct measure of foreign capital arriving, and arriving capital eventually leaves.
live_hypotheses.information_edge: Real per-contract open interest across fifteen non-US index markets in the R38 dated layer; EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES carries 923 settled tests, all price-state.
live_hypotheses.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Cross-border allocation decisions are made on quarterly committee cycles, so the flow is predictable in direction and slow in execution.
live_hypotheses.not_a_repeat_because: EQUITY_INDEX_CROSS_ASSET_CARRY_R64 is closed - this is not carry and must not reduce to it. INTL_INDEX_TREND_FX_REVERSAL_XA_CURVE is closed - this is not trend. It is a positioning quantity. This is a SECOND application of the PH07 mechanism to a different asset class and counts against the 3-variants-per-idea limit; drop it if PH07 is running and budget is tight.

This is a data outcome, not a selection choice. DO NOT pad the campaign with price formulas to reach a ratio - that is the exact failure this campaign exists to avoid.
